latest.title: Parameter-uniform Robin uniqueness on large dilations
latest.abstract: Berestycki and Graham proved large-dilation uniqueness for bounded positive solutions of $-Δu=f(u)$ in $κΩ$, with $u+α\partial_νu=0$ on $\partial(κΩ)$, when $α$ is fixed, and remarked that the dilation threshold should not depend on $α$. We show that it does not, including at the Dirichlet and Neumann endpoints, for possibly unbounded uniformly $C^{2,γ}$ domains. The half-space linearizations retain a common positive spectral gap across the compactified boundary parameter. The remaining endpoint difficulty is nonlinear compactness at the Dirichlet end, where the Robin coefficient diverges. Rescaling at its reciprocal scale makes the limiting equation harmonic. Any trace that persisted in this limit would give a bounded harmonic half-space solution of $\partial_νv+v=0$, which a Liouville lemma rules out. Combining this endpoint compactness with the half-space gap and localization gives uniform large-dilation uniqueness. When $\partialΩ\neq\varnothing$, we further obtain convergence of the spectral bottom to its half-space value with error $O(κ^{-1/2})$. For bounded $C^{4,γ}$ domains the boundary layer also has a first mean-curvature correction, with remainder $O(κ^{-1-γ}+κ^{-2})$ on each fixed boundary strip.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究 Robin 大尺度极限的唯一性、反应族一致性和参数均匀曲率修正，核心是边界层半空间谱问题。
latest.breakthrough: Theorems 1.1–1.3 分别给出 uniform uniqueness、反应族一致性和曲率修正。
latest.limitations: 依赖 Robin 参数、反应项条件和边界局部曲率；大尺度极限按文中 compact reaction family 处理。

steps.claim: Lemma 2.1 提供 Robin 算子的 bounded weak maximum principle。
steps.route: 对截断正部测试弱方程，利用椭圆性和 Robin 边界符号控制负部，从而建立唯一性所需的比较原理。

steps.claim: Lemma 2.2 与 Theorem 2.3 将边界层约化到半空间谱问题。
steps.route: 通过法向缩放把曲率边界局部化为半空间，利用 Fourier/变分比较得到 potential-bearing Robin–Lieb localization。

steps.claim: Proposition 3.1 与 Theorems 1.1–1.3 完成大尺度渐近。
steps.route: 显式计算半空间 profile 的平移公式和谱隙，将局部误差与曲率项积分回原域，得到均匀唯一性和参数修正。
